audit: P9 carry series (carry_roundtrip.jsonl / carry_series_summary.json / CARRY_SERIES.md) - venue-mixing + fee-vs-spread attribution + fee-vs-funding decomposition
venue_finding: summary aggregates BY SYMBOL ONLY, pooling all venues. Current data is binance 7 / bybit 7 / okx 518. CARRY_SERIES.md line 'Instruments are not combined across venues - binance only' is FALSE on current data (97.4% okx); bybit (6bp taker) is blended into okx/binance (5bp) medians.
fee_attribution_finding: roundtrip_cost_bps = 2 x taker_fee_bps + spread_bps. taker_fee_bps is a HARDCODED published-default-tier constant (binance/okx 5.0, bybit 6.0) in carry_roundtrip.py VENUES, never a measured fill. 89.83% of the 11.13 bp round-trip median is this ASSUMED fee; only 1.13 bp is measured top-of-book spread. The summary JSON and CARRY_SERIES.md headline present 11.13 as a cost without decomposition or an ASSUMED tag. (T4/CARRY_RTT_T4.md already separates these and states fees are 89-95% - P9 lags the repo standard.)
fee_vs_funding_finding: net carry is negative on 0-of-532. But under a ZERO-FEE counterfactual (funding_bps - spread_bps, taker fee set to 0) net is positive on 18.42% of ticks (max +0.98 bp); on BTC okx it is positive on 94.6% of ticks (median funding +0.365 bp vs spread ~0.017 bp). So the 0-of-532 null is FEE-DRIVEN, not 'funding is zero'. CARRY_SERIES.md reading 'funding ~ 0 across the majors ... so net carry is negative' mis-attributes it to funding.
verdict: KILL UNCHANGED: net carry is negative after any realistic taker fee (>=2bp round trip eats the <1bp funding) on all 532 ticks; even at the observed 5bp default tier it is negative everywhere. Only the ATTRIBUTION and INTERPRETATION are corrected. No gate lowered. Capturing the small positive BTC/ETH funding-spread needs maker fills, which A7 (KILO) records as UNMEASURED.
hermes_tags: H3: assumed fee not tagged ASSUMED in summary/headline
A9/horizon: P9 net carry is per 8h interval (immediate round trip); T4 uses 90-day amortization - different horizons, not interchangeable
hard-rule: instruments pooled across venues while doc claims binance-only
